LEGAL / QUIZ RUN

Privacy Policy

Effective date: November 4, 2026

Quiz Run is published by Bohdan Zadorozhnyi ("we", "us", or "our"). This Privacy Policy explains how Quiz Run handles information when you use the game on Android, iPhone, or iPad. Features and providers can vary by platform and released version.

Local game data

Quiz Run stores progress, coins, settings, run history, mistakes for revision and custom question packs on your device. Images selected for custom cards are stored for those cards. Local monetization counters record events such as completed rewarded videos; these counters are not a separate network analytics service.

You can remove custom packs in the game. Uninstalling generally removes local app data; operating-system backups can affect this. Removing local data does not delete records independently held by online, purchase or advertising providers.

Online play

Online play uses Unity Gaming Services, including authentication and lobby services. These services process information needed for matches, such as a service-generated player identifier, nickname, room membership and results. Other participants can see your shared nickname and match information. Do not put sensitive information in your nickname. Providers may also process connection and device information under their policies.

Advertising and privacy choices

The mobile app is integrated with Unity LevelPlay mediation and its configured advertising providers, including Unity Ads and ironSource where enabled. Ads can include optional rewarded videos and full-screen ads between runs. Rewarded ads provide a benefit after completion is confirmed; you can play without choosing to watch one.

Advertising providers may process device and app information, IP addresses, advertising identifiers where permitted and ad interactions to deliver, measure and protect advertising. Data use and personalization depend on your choices, applicable requirements and the providers enabled in the released app.

Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) presents the publisher's configured privacy messages and stores privacy choices and related consent signals. The game checks UMP's current permission before requesting ads. Permission to request ads is not treated as permission to personalize them.

In versions with privacy controls enabled, use Settings → Privacy → Advertising choices, where available, to review or change choices. Rejecting personalized advertising does not prevent gameplay. Limited or non-personalized ads may still be available where allowed by applicable requirements and the provider's permission result. If the game cannot establish permission to request ads, it continues without requesting them. Device privacy controls are also available in operating-system settings; consent does not replace a separately required platform tracking permission.

Purchases

Where purchases are available, app stores process payment. Purchase-related services may process transaction and entitlement information to verify purchases, unlock features and restore purchases. We do not receive complete payment-card details through the game. Store records follow the store's privacy and retention practices.

Children's privacy

Quiz Run is a general-audience app, not specifically directed to children under 13. Contact us if you believe a child's information has been processed inappropriately through the game.

Third-party platforms

Relevant provider policies include:

  • Unity Privacy Policy: Unity Gaming Services, Unity Ads and LevelPlay.
  • ironSource Privacy Policy.
  • Google Privacy Policy: Google UMP and applicable Google services.
  • The privacy policies and purchase terms of Google Play or Apple App Store, as applicable.

Providers retain information under their own policies and applicable requirements. Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct or delete information, restrict or object to processing, and withdraw consent. Contact us for help identifying information we control and the appropriate provider for other requests.

Changes to this policy

If the game's data practices change, we will update this policy and its effective date before releasing the relevant update.

Contact

For privacy or support questions, contact quizrun.support@gmail.com.
